title: Peer evaluation model and pages
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.

models.name: PeerEvaluationDocument
models.work: schema, repo, submit + summary actions, UI

build: src/app/actions/submit-peer-evaluation.ts (student): evaluatee must be a different teammate on the same team, scores are integers 1 to 10 for punctuality, technical_contribution and teamwork, average_score computed server-side to 1 decimal, immutable once written, allowed when team.status is defense_ready or completed.

src/lib/peer/summary.ts (pure): summarise(ratings) returns per-student mean of ratings received, count, and a free-rider flag when the mean is below 75 percent of the team mean or below 5. Unit-tested.
src/app/actions/get-peer-summary.ts: assigned supervisor, coordinator or admin; returns only aggregates (no rater identities, no raw rows).

/peer-evaluation student view: one card per teammate with three sliders, comments, a single confirm-and-submit step that warns it cannot be changed, then a read-only 'submitted' state; students never see any rating about themselves. Supervisor/coordinator view: summary table with flags and a note that peer data is advisory for the team's continuous assessment.
rules: Peer ratings never change individual marks (D-02)
out_of_scope: Changing evaluation scores based on peer data
acceptance: Self-rating, non-teammate rating and a second submission are rejected
Summary output contains no rater ids
